verdicts.reason: Both banners have the same faults: the invite line and the dates are too small to read at this height, and a small decorative cross has been blown up into a blurry focal point that pulls attention from the headline. In A the cross stays inside the frame and 'Worship & Bible Study' sits under it as in the original, though that line nearly touches the bottom edge. In B the cross runs the full banner height and is cut off at the top and bottom, which makes it even more dominant and pixelated, so B is slightly worse.
